---
name: "nf-core/fasta_index_dna"
description: "Generate aligner index for a reference genome.\nPlease note, this workflow\
  \ requires input CHANNELS. Input values will cause errors\n"
keywords:
- "fasta"
- "index"
- "bowtie2"
- "bwamem"
- "bwamem2"
- "bwamem3"
- "dragmap"
- "snapaligner"
components:
- "bowtie2/build"
- "bwa/index"
- "bwamem2/index"
- "bwamem3/index"
- "dragmap/hashtable"
- "snapaligner/index"
input:
- ch_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "Reference genome fasta file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(fasta)\
      \ ]\n"
- ch_altliftover:
    type: "file"
    description: "Sam formatted liftover file for the reference genome alt contigs.\n\
      Only used if the aligner is `snap`.\nSee: https://github.com/lh3/bwa/blob/master/README-alt.md\n\
      Download from: https://sourceforge.net/projects/bio-bwa/files/bwakit\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta2), path(altliftover) ]\n"
- val_aligner:
    type: "string"
    description: "Aligner to use for alignment"
    enum:
    - "bowtie2"
    - "bwamem"
    - "bwamem2"
    - "dragmap"
    - "snap"
output:
- index:
    type: "file"
    description: "Aligner index.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(index) ]\n"
authors:
- "@matthdsm"
- "@ramprasadn"
maintainers:
- "@matthdsm"
- "@ramprasadn"
version: "0.0.0-5eae6c7"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/bowtie2/build@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/bwa/index@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/bwamem2/index@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/bwamem3/index@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/dragmap/hashtable@0.0.0-3c23b0c"
  - "nf-core/snapaligner/index@0.0.0-6d1763b"
